_comment: Retrieval golden set: natural-language questions over the frozen reference corpus at evals/corpus/, scoring Recall@5 per arm (lexical, vector, RRF, final) so a ranking change shows which arm moved. Run with --embedder fake for a keyless plumbing check and --embedder openai for the real measurement.
_filters_comment: The questions whose SUBJECT is a named entity declare filters.entity, so the run exercises the entity-membership clause of the query rather than being structurally blind to it. Each value is the entity: frontmatter of that question's expected page(s), and tests/evals/test_golden_corpus_fixture.py asserts that every filtered question's expected pages really carry that entity — a filter naming an entity its own answer does not have would delete its own answer from both arms and score 0 forever while reading as a retrieval regression.
